changelog: VeilNet-Nano: Lightweight on-device neural sensor fingerprint protection with high-fidelity detail preservation
Real-Time Verification: Automatic self-audit measuring sensor correlation attenuation on exported media
Model Integrity: Cryptographic SHA-256 verification and size bounds enforcement for all on-demand neural weights
Privacy Scanner Assurance: Reliable multimodal scan diagnostics with transparent status reporting
Classification Precision: Enhanced vehicle and electronic device detection for accurate redactions
Memory & Stability: Comprehensive native memory optimizations and full GPL-3.0 licensing compliance
PDF Processing: File-backed merge, split, signing, Office/HTML conversion, form filling and image ZIP exports reduce large in-memory output buffers
PDF Save & Unlock: Save confirmation waits for successful system document write; disk-backed unlock and bounded previews improve cancellation and memory safety
PDF Print & Reorder: Asynchronous printing with repeated-write cleanup, correct drag insertion and fewer thumbnail rerenders
Document Scanner: Stream page-by-page ZIP/PDF exports, release temporary bitmap memory and clean up incomplete outputs
Video Studio: Job-owned FFmpeg sessions prevent cross-operation cancellations and clean up abandoned stabilization/redaction outputs
Image Matting: Preserve morphology-enhanced masks during connected-component cleanup and harden image export error handling
Reliability: Expanded regression coverage and runtime diagnostics, with no unverified performance-speedup claims
